description: This file defines the HashBasedPlacementDirector class, which implements the IPlacementDirector interface for placing grains on silos based on hash algorithms within the Orleans runtime.

classes.name: HashBasedPlacementDirector
classes.description: Implements a hash-based placement strategy for grains in Orleans.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Determines the target silo for a new grain activation using a hash-based placement algorithm, considering placement hints if provided.
